verdict.rationale: Raygun documents some API surfaces of its own: a Deployments API, API-based source map, dSYM and ProGuard uploads authenticated by an external access token, and an official MCP server. That shows real but narrow programmatic access. Core UI workflows have no documented API equivalent: error status triage, ignore rules, CSV export, filtering, AI resolution and settings like disabling IP storage. No OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented API coverage of error triage, status and ignore management, data export and search, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec showing UI parity, and independent corroboration of parity.
